SPEC:
# Diagram spec: LFM3-1.7B
# Generated by archwatch.diagram_spec from the published, verifier-approved fields of
# LiquidAI/LFM3-1.7B at commit 1da06bec6a. No value here comes from an LLM.
# The diagram must use ONLY what is written here. If something is not here, leave it out.

model:
  name: LFM3-1.7B
  title_label: LFM3-1.7B
  total_params: 1.73B
  layers: 24
  hidden_size: 2048
  vocabulary: 128,000 (128K)
  context_length: 256K tokens (262,144)
  embedding: tied to the LM head
layer_pattern:
  summary: 13 ShortConv + 6 Global GQA + 5 Sliding-window GQA layers
  compressed_view:
  - repeat: 2
    layers:
    - ShortConv + FFN
    note: layers 1-2
  - repeat: 5
    layers:
    - Global GQA + FFN
    - ShortConv + FFN
    - Sliding-window GQA + FFN
    - ShortConv + FFN
    note: layers 3-22
  - repeat: 1
    layers:
    - Global GQA + FFN
    - ShortConv + FFN
    note: layers 23-24
decoder_layer:
- norm (pre-mixer)
- 'Token mixer: ShortConv or Global GQA or Sliding-window GQA (see zoom panels)'
- norm (post-mixer)
- residual add
- norm (pre-FFN)
- FFN (see zoom panels)
- norm (post-FFN)
- residual add
zoom_panels:
  short_conv:
    title: Gated ShortConv (13 layers)
    parts:
    - 'in_proj: Linear 2048 -> 6144, split into three parts B, C and x (2048 each)'
    - B multiplied with x, then depthwise Conv1d (kernel 7), then multiplied with C
    - 'out_proj: Linear 2048 -> 2048'
    - keeps only the last few inputs; cache does not grow with context
    flow: bottom to top, in the order listed
  gqa:
    title: GQA attention (6 global + 5 sliding-window layers)
    parts:
    - 16 query heads, 4 key/value heads, head size 128
    - 'q: Linear 2048 -> 2048; k and v: Linear 2048 -> 512 each'
    - QK-norm on q and k (per head, 128)
    - 'global layers: partial rotary (half of each head), theta 1,000,000, attend to all tokens'
    - 'sliding-window layers: full rotary, theta 10,000, attend to the last 256 tokens only'
    - 'head-wise output gate: Linear 2048 -> 16 (one gate per head)'
    - 'output projection: Linear 2048 -> 2048'
    flow: bottom to top, in the order listed
  ffn:
    title: SwiGLU FFN
    parts:
    - 'w1 and w3: Linear 2048 -> 7680 in parallel; SiLU on w1; multiply'
    - 'w2: Linear 7680 -> 2048'
    flow: bottom to top, in the order listed
io:
  bottom:
  - Tokenized text
  - Token embedding 128,000 x 2048
  top:
  - Final norm
  - LM head (shares weights with the token embedding)
callouts:
- 'Context length: 256K tokens'
- 13 ShortConv + 6 Global GQA + 5 Sliding-window GQA
- 16 Q / 4 KV heads
- 'Vocabulary: 128K'
- 'KV cache: 12 KB per token (only the 6 global layers grow)'
do_not_include:
- any benchmark scores
- any number not in this file
- logos or watermarks
